name: Diesel storage and transfer
description: Bulk marine gasoil is bunkered from shore/vessel to the installation, held in storage and day tanks, and transferred to emergency gensets, fire pumps and crane engines. The read guidance sets fuel quality, microbial and water limits, tank inspection and bunkering controls; JIP33 S-714/S-721 give day-tank and fuel-system design requirements. Primary source: https://www.marinesafetyforum.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/MSF_Guidance-Delivering_Fuel_Cargoes_to_Offshore_Locations_Dec2018.pdf
aliases: Diesel storage and transfer (fuel for emergency gensets and cranes)

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Maximum sulphur content (SECA)
specifications.basis: Offshore Installations in the North Sea fall within a Sulphur Emission Control Area (SECA) that limits ships to use fuel with a maximum sulphur content of 0.1%

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Minimum flash point
specifications.basis: According to the International Convention for Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) the Flash Point must be a minimum of 60°C

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Pour point, summer / winter
specifications.basis: This is 0°C in summer and -6°C in winter

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Cold filter plugging point, summer / winter (BS 2869)
specifications.basis: The BS:2869 specification is -4°C in Summer and -12°C in Winter

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Maximum fuel retained onboard before testing
specifications.basis: fuel is not retained onboard for more than 30 days

specifications.metric: Marine gasoil (MGO) bulk storage and day — Day tank minimum operating level above fuel injection pump inlet
specifications.basis: The day tank minimum operating level shall be 300 mm (12 in) above inlet of the fuel injection pump where a positive static head is required

specifications.metric: Reliability — Water content - negligible / moderate / heavy
specifications.basis: Water content (e.g. by IP438): Negligible <100 mg/kg; Moderate 100 - 200 mg/kg; Heavy >200 mg/kg

specifications.metric: Reliability — Total viable count of culturable bacteria/yeasts/moulds
specifications.basis: Total Viable Count of culturable bacteria, yeasts and/or moulds (e.g. by IP385 / ASTM D6974 or IP613): Negligible <10^4 CFU/Litre; Moderate 10^4 - 10^5 CFU/Litre; Heavy >10^5 CFU/Litre

specifications.metric: Price — Diesel standby fuel infrastructure - day tank
specifications.basis: a day tank (2,000–8,000) ... fuel infrastructure cost ranges, 2026 vendor pricing guide; dollar year 2026.

specifications.metric: Price — Diesel standby fuel infrastructure - bulk storage tank
specifications.basis: bulk storage tank (8,000–60,000+ depending on capacity); dollar year 2026.

specifications.metric: Price — Fuel infrastructure for 500 kW / 72 h autonomy
specifications.basis: For a 500 kW facility requiring 72 hours of autonomous runtime, fuel infrastructure can add 25,000–50,000 to the total project; dollar year 2026.
Fuel cost per kWh - Diesel Standby: 0.08–0.15; dollar year 2026.
